notes: Source basis: kartavkun general configs and zapret2 config.default emphasize list-general/Cloudflare/Discord buckets plus multisplit/multidisorder first-data profiles.
This strategy uses profiles/hostlists/reference-general.hosts as a curated non-runnable host bucket; the default profile hostlist is still appended by runtime for compatibility.
High Discord/Cloudflare TLS-like ports are made explicit in capturePolicy and in the TLS filter, but UDP/voice remains off.
This is a candidate for observation, not a claim that multisplit/multidisorder will fix Discord on this network.
